![Macedonian Wedding Reception Venue In Melbourne - The Luxor](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11020611-2247-0139-0000-e041c1eadac9:4)
Macedonian wedding traditions `blend ancient Orthodox religious rites with lively, community-focused folk customs that often span an entire weekend`.[[1]](https://normanyap.com.au/macedonian-wedding-traditions/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/tetai.magno/videos/macedonian-wedding-legendaryskopje-wedding-balkan-dance-reena-babon-maria-theres/1616122766747768/)

### Morning Rituals at Home

- **Groom's Shaving:** Family members and friends jokingly "shave" the groom on the wedding morning using oversized or playful props like axes, swords, or wooden tools.[[1]](https://www.iklektikink.com/copy-of-croatian-wedding-traditions)[[2]](https://weddedwonderland.com/7-exciting-and-unusual-things-to-expect-at-a-macedonian-wedding)
- **Baking the Bread:** Relatives bake round, decorative wedding breads (*koluk* ), which symbolize an unbroken circle of life and unity.[[1]](http://www.talesofadream.com/toad-blog/2016/3/28/heather-vlados-wedding-may-9-2015)[[2]](https://www.macedoniancuisine.com/2016/09/macedonian-wedding-customs.html)
- **Buying the Bride:** Groomsmen, the best man (*dever* ), and family members travel to the bride's home, where they barter, sing, and negotiate with the bride's family to "claim" her.[[1]](https://weddedwonderland.com/7-exciting-and-unusual-things-to-expect-at-a-macedonian-wedding)[[2]](https://www.macedoniancuisine.com/2016
